name: Ellie Bluebell
source:
Ellie, the mysterious new girl who shows up on the final week of classes... She says she's always been enrolled at the school, but May seems unconvinced. Definitely comes across as a sweetie though!

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/jagogames/the-lost-delinquents-of-rollings-high-visual-novel?ref=profile_saved_projects_live]Kickstarter[/url]]
